title: enhanced-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflows
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Enhances canary/A-B/shadow rollout workflows with multi-metric quorum checks, improved quarantine handling, and safer auto-rollback thresholds. No API breaking changes.
description: Context: customers continue to push heavier LLM traffic patterns and we observed edge cases where transient metric spikes caused noisy rollouts or missed regressions. This PR adds multi-metric quorum logic, a configurable quarantine stage with manual override, and tighter safety guards for canary/A-B/shadow auto-rollback workflows to reduce false positives while maintaining quick failure recovery. Changes include: 1) new composite-metric quorum engine that combines latency/error/quality metrics with configurable weights and quorum percentage; 2) quarantine probing stage support that isolates suspect traffic for extended observation and allows manual or automated promotion/quarantine release; 3) extended rollback windows and cooldown periods to avoid oscillations; 4) better observability: added per-rollout metric breakdowns, alert mappings, and tracing hooks; 5) e2e tests and stability guards for the staged workflows. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in ENG-8271 - [x] Unit tests for quorum logic - [x] Integration tests for quarantine stage - [x] Telemetry dashboards updated - [x] Load-tested with perf lab (1M requests sim) - [x] Security review signoff. Migration notes: rollout configs gain optional new fields (quorum_metrics, quarantine.window_ms, quarantine.manual_override) but default behavior preserves prior semantics. Backwards compatibility: existing rollout specs continue to work without changes. Testing: local unit + integration + perf-canary runs; CI initially failed on lint (fixed), then flakiness in e2e fixed by additional stability guard; final run green. Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature flag rollout.quorum_v2=false by default; enable gradually for internal canaries then opt-in for customers. Rollback behavior: automatic rollback occurs when composite quorum fails sustained over configured window; quarantine stage halts promotion and emits high-priority alert for manual review; automated quarantine release possible when probe metrics stabilize. See commits and review conversation for details.
commits: add: composite metric quorum engine and unit tests
feat: quarantine probing stage and manual override
perf: optimize quorum evaluation hot path
obs: add rollout metric breakdown and trace hooks
tests: add e2e stability guards for staged canary/AB/shadow
fix: lint and flakiness in e2e tests
review_comments: Diego Martinez: Overall looks good. Two requests: make quorum weights pluggable via config and add rate limiter guard when quarantine probe increases request fanout.

Ava Chen: Thanks Diego, added weights to rollout config and included an optional global default in feature flags. Added a rate-limiter to quarantine probe path (services/rollouts/quarantine_stage.go).
Priya Kapoor: Observability LGTM but we need clear alert severities mapped to incident playbooks. Can you wire alerts to runbook IDs?
Ava Chen: Wired alerts to runbook id RR-QUARANTINE-1 in docs/runbooks/quarantine-playbook.md and added alert labels for severity/owner.

Liam O'Connor: Tests look comprehensive; one nit on a magic constant in autorollback_engine.go, prefer named const. Also request a short e2e that simulates transient spikes to validate cooldown behavior.
Ava Chen: Replaced magic constant with named const RolloutCooldownWindow and added transient-spike e2e in tests/e2e/rollouts/transient_spike_test.go. Thanks for the review!
Priya Kapoor: Approving after runbook wiring and tests. +1
ci_summary: CI timeline: initial run (linux-unit, go-lint, python-style, e2e) failed on go-lint; fixed lint issues and re-ran. Second run showed intermittent e2e failure due to test flakiness; added stability guards and re-ran. Final run: all checks passed (linux-unit: pass, go-lint: pass, python-style: pass, e2e: pass, perf-canary: pass).
post_merge_actions: Feature flagged off by default (rollout.quorum_v2=false). Post-merge: deploy rollout controller to canary cluster, enable feature flag for internal canaries, monitor rollout_quorum dashboards and alerting for 48h, and schedule follow-up to enable opt-in SDK examples.
notes_for_release: Adds safer auto-rollback workflows and quarantine stage; operators should review new rollout config fields and update any automation that parses rollout specs. No customer-facing API changes by default.
